summary: LakeShore Biopharma filed an amended merger agreement for a going-private transaction. Parent Oceanpine Skyline and Merger Sub will acquire the company for US$0.066 per share in cash, implying an equity value of ~US$2.7 million. The consideration is a 46.7% premium to the March 24, 2026 closing price. The board has not disclosed a recommendation or advisors. The amendment reduced the original US$0.90 price and lowered termination fees to US$50,000 (company) and US$100,000 (parent). Closing is subject to shareholder approval and regulatory conditions. Watch for potential dissenting shareholder actions or further adjustments.
